regime_read: The desk's deterministic channels are clustering around AI-infrastructure and semiconductor capital-equipment names, with the tightest convergence in NVDA (5 channels + Pelosi stake + Cramer chatter) and PLTR (gov-contract acceleration + Trump-linked, though the trump_side flag reads 'sell'). Track record is empty, so every read here is uncalibrated and must stay modest.
regime_read_zh: 本台确定性通道正在向人工智能基础设施与半导体资本开支方向聚拢，收敛最紧的是 NVDA（5 个通道 + 佩洛西持股 + 克莱默提及）与 PLTR（政府合同加速 + 与特朗普关联，但 trump_side 标志为卖出）。战绩记录为空，因此所有标的判断都未经验证，必须保持克制。

theses.thesis: NVDA shows the deepest multi-channel convergence: it ties together analyst upgrades, patent activity, retail buzz (WSB mentions 207), and special-situation context. Nancy Pelosi holds a disclosed stake, alongside Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul, and Paul Pelosi is affiliated through the paired relationship. Jensen Huang directly controls. Jim Cramer's chatter is priced as a purely inverse/qualitative signal, but it confirms the name is in motion. What keeps me cautious: rs_vs_spy_60d is only +6.1, so the stock has NOT run away from the market, which is why ACCUMULATE is defensible here. The second-order read is that GPU accumulation implies memory (MU), semicap equipment (AMAT, INTC), and AI datacenter power/infrastructure (HUT via the label-mismatch repoint).
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA 展现出最深的多通道汇聚：它将分析师上调、专利活动、散户热度与特殊事件背景绑在一起。南希·佩洛西持有披露仓位，玛乔丽·泰勒·格林与迈克尔·麦克考尔也持股，保罗·佩洛西通过配对关系有联系。黄仁勋直接控制公司。吉姆·克莱默的提及是逆指标，但确实说明该股正在被讨论。让我谨慎的是 60 日相对 SPY 仅为 +6.1，因此股价并未脱离大盘，这为 ACCUMULATE 提供了依据。二阶衍生产业为 GPU 采购带动的存储（MU）、半导体设备（AMAT、INTC）以及 AI 数据中心电力/基础设施（经标签修正后的 HUT）。
second_order: MU — GPU 内存需求带动 [insider_mspr:100 + congress_cluster]
AMAT — 领先逻辑/存储资本开支带动 [analyst_upgrade, congress_cluster]
INTC — 美政府拨款 + 专利 [gov_grant, analyst_upgrade]
HUT — AI 数据中心电力/基础设施主题，经标签修正重指 [label_mismatch repointed_ticker]
evidence: channels: analyst_upgrade_cluster, cnbc_pick, hf_model_momentum, patent_cluster, retail_buzz, special_situation
actor: Pelosi HOLDS_STAKE + Paul Pelosi AFFILIATES_WITH
theses.dissent: Cramer's documented presence and an already-crowded franchise can make this a top-ticking exercise. DPI_z sits at -0.36, suggesting positioning is not yet stretched, but the stock is never cheap.

falsifier.text: NVDA loses relative strength through the next two earnings cycles while semicap peers (AMAT, INTC) hold up

theses.thesis: PLTR has the strongest government-contract acceleration in the pack (gov_contract_accel 1.76), a Trump-linked flag, and substantial analytic convergence. But the trump_side reads 'sell,' not 'buy' — this is a direct contradiction with the retail-bull signal. MTG's disclosed stake plus Cathie Wood's AFFILIATES_WITH link only compound the noise. rs_vs_spy_60d is +25.8, and while the pack does not flag it as extended (below +35), the run has already been substantial. The right entry posture is WATCH: let either the contract acceleration show up in next earnings, or wait for a 60d relative-strength mean reversion to take advantage. Second-order beneficiaries are government-IT peers (BA via Cramer's endorsement and gov_grant, MSFT via Altman partnership, and the broader defense software complex).
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR 拥有本包中最大幅度的政府合同加速（gov_contract_accel 1.76）、与特朗普关联的标签以及显著的多通道趋同。但 trump_side 读数为卖出而非买入——这与散户看多信号直接矛盾。MTG 的披露持股和凯西·伍德的关联只会增加噪声。60 日相对 SPY 为 +25.8，虽然未超过 +35 得以称为超买，但涨幅已十分可观。因此正确姿势是 WATCH：要么等下季财报验证合同加速，要么等 60 日相对强度均值回归后再介入。二阶受益包括政府 IT 同道（BA，受克莱默背书和 gov_grant 拉动；MSFT，与奥特曼合伙），以及更广泛的国防软件板块。
second_order: BA — 政府合同 + 专利申请 + 克莱默背书 [gov_grant, patent_cluster]
MSFT — 奥特曼合伙 + 云基础设施 [actors: Sam Altman PARTNERS_WITH]
INTC — 政府拨款与结构性半导体定位 [gov_grant, analyst_upgrade]
evidence: channels: gov_contract (accel 1.76), analyst_upgrade_cluster, retail_buzz, stocktwits_bull, trump
theses.dissent: The Trump-side sell signal cuts directly against the equity-bull story, and PLTR's valuation is especially fragile to any rate regime shift.

falsifier.text: PLTR's next quarterly filing does not show a sustained pick-up in government-contract revenue despite the acceleration flag

theses.thesis: MU carries the clearest single-asset setup: an insider_mspr of 100 (no sellers, only buyers), a non-trivial congressional cluster (congress_net 6, three members), FDA-adjacent grant acceleration (gov_grant_accel 0.32 on $1.4M), and 400 patents. Ro Khanna's AFFILIATES_WITH is a qualitative signal. Critically, MU is NOT extended — rs_vs_spy_60d is -3.6, and days-to-earnings is 21. This is one of the few names where the entry is still live. Thesis: the DRAM supercycle is showing up in this alt-data as early-stage accumulation before NVDA's AI demand releases completely through the channel.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 拥有最清晰的单一资产配置：insider_mspr 为 100（无卖出者），国会聚集不弱（congress_net 6、3 名议员），拨款加速（gov_grant_accel 0.32，金额 140 万美元），专利 400 项。罗·卡纳的 AFFILIATES_WITH 是定性信号。关键是 MU 并未超买——60 日相对 SPY 为 -3.6，距离财报还有 21 天。这是少数仍然有入场窗口的标的。逻辑是：DRAM 超级周期在本次另类数据中表现为 NVDA 的 AI 需求完全传导前期的建仓迹象。
second_order: NVDA — AI 驱动 GPU 需求 [patent_cluster, analyst_upgrade_cluster]
AMAT — 内存设备资本开支 [analyst_upgrade_cluster, congress_cluster]
INTC — 美国重建制造业 [gov_grant, patent_cluster]
theses.dissent: Memory is extremely cyclical; a single inventory correction in smartphones would kill the thesis instantly.

falsifier.text: MU's next earnings release trades below the pre-earnings 60-day VWAP even with a positive surprise

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MRK is the only name where the Trump signal is explicitly bullish (trump_side 'buy'). Combined with 11 Phase-3 clinical starts, an FDA label expansion, and special-situation context, the read is targeted pharma upside. But the stock is already +19.7 vs SPY – more than AMAT or INTC, and near the top of the non-extended band. The healthcare bill catalysts (Cancer Care Planning and Communications Act) provide a plausible macro tailwind. Entering now is okay for a slow accumulation, but the 90-day horizon warrants a WATCH first.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK 是本包中唯一一个特朗普信号明确看多的标的（trump_side buy）。叠加 11 个 III 期临床启动、FDA 标签扩展以及特殊事件背景，其定位是精准的制药增量。但该股相对 SPY 达 +19.7%，高于 AMAT 和 INTC，接近非超买区间上沿。医疗保健相关法案（癌症护理规划和沟通法案）提供了合理的长尾驱动。现在入场可缓步建仓，但 90 天视野建议先 WATCH。
second_order: ABBV — 同为 III 期临床 + FDA 标签扩展 [clinical_phase3_start, fda_label_expansion]
Healthcare service names tied to Medicare coverage bills [bill_catalysts HR10087]
theses.dissent: The 3 clinical halts may indicate a pipeline quality issue; the phase-3 starts alone don't guarantee approvals.

falsifier.text: MRK's oncology pipeline reports a Phase-3 miss or FDA complete response letter despite the starts

theses.thesis: AAPL ties to several political actors: Dan Crenshaw holds a stake, Paul Pelosi and Marjorie Taylor Greene are affiliated, and Buffett's association with the name is disclosed. With 576 patents and a $1.17B congressional position, there's ongoing buying interest. But the convergence score is only 4 — not exceptional. The stock is up +3.0 vs SPY, not extended. This is a slow, low-conviction buy for a diversified mega-cap allocation.
theses.thesis_zh: AAPL 与多名政治人物有关联：丹·克伦肖持股、保罗·佩洛西与玛乔丽·泰勒·格林关联、巴菲特亦有披露关系。576 项专利、11.7 亿美元国会持仓表明持续买入兴趣。但趋同分数仅为 4——谈不上特殊。股价相对 SPY +3.0，未超买。适合分散化大型科技配置的缓慢低违信看多。
second_order: MSFT — AI/云基础设施伙伴 [Sam Altman PARTNERS_WITH]
BRK.B — 巴菲特持仓关联 [13f_add, affiliation]
theses.dissent: AAPL is mature; a 13F add at this size is more likely rebalancing than new thesis formation.

falsifier.text: Apple's flagship product cycle misses consensus and political buying flatlines in the next disclosure window
